fieldValues.title: Slice package closure
fieldValues.content:
A container slice carries every package of the source's package set that it uses, whole and unchanged: the same files at the same path relative to the repository root, with the same `id` and `version`, never pruned, merged or re-identified (RFC-026 [R15]). A package it does not use is not carried.

The used set is computed in the source's effective package set (the RFC-014 union, with the RFC-029 core package). The source's primary package is always used. The seeds are each included record's Type, and the RelationTypeDefinition each included relation's `relationType` key resolves to. The relation-type key is KEYED, but it is followed here because an unresolved relation type is a validation error (RFC-005). Each seed is followed through the PINNED and LINEAGE reference sites of the Package export reference sites table (RFC-003), transitively, and every package listing a reached definition is used. Then, until nothing is added: every definition of every used package is followed the same way; and for each RFC-044 `packageDependencies` entry of a used package, every source package with that `packageId` whose `version` satisfies the entry is used. A Container's `tags` are KEYED and are not followed.

A used `remote` package reference is carried as the same reference. The core package is never carried (Invariant 85). The slice manifest's `packageRef`/`packageRefs` list exactly the carried packages, unchanged and in the source's order; with none, it carries neither. A requirement the source does not satisfy stays unsatisfied, with the same warning. A reference that resolves in no source package is not an export failure; it stays unresolved, as in the source. The exporter MUST refuse and write nothing, with `slice-root-level-package-unsupported`, when a local package's directory is the repository root.
